002/**
003 * JukeBox Coin Box
004 * Simple coin box for Jukebox
005 * @author Jason Jiang
006 * @version 1.0
007 */
008
009 // inital copied from : Vending Machine project
010public class JukeBoxCoinBox {
011
012    final private char acceptable_coin_chars[]={'p', 'n', 'd', 'q', 'h', 'g'};
013    final private int acceptable_coin_vals[] = {1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100};
014    private int changeSet[] = {0,0,0,0,0,0};
015    /**
016     * Returns updated balance from coins that coinBox has as part of the user's balance
017     * @return updated users's coin balance
018     */
019    public int changeValue(){
020        int acc = 0;
021        for (int i = 0; i < changeSet.length; i++){
022            acc += acceptable_coin_vals[i] * changeSet[i];
023        }
024        return acc;
025    }
026    /**
027     * Holds info about the amount of coins the current user has as part of balance.
028     */
029    public JukeBoxCoinBox(){
030        for (int i = 0; i < changeSet.length; i++){{
031            changeSet[i] = 0;
032        }}
033    }
034    /**
035     * Accepts coin and returns a changed balance
036     * able to accept: 'p', 'n', 'd', 'q', 'h', 'g'
037     * @param coinType the  coin  thats  being added
038     * @return the new balance after adding coin
039     */
040    public int acceptCoin(char coinType){
041        for (int i =0; i < acceptable_coin_chars.length; i++){
042            if  (acceptable_coin_chars[i] == coinType){
043                changeSet[i] ++;
044                return acceptable_coin_vals[i];
045            }
046        }
047        System.out.println("Please enter a valid coin.");
048        return 0;
049    }
050    /**
051     * subtractCertainBalance takes away correct amount of coins from the coin box
052     * @param cost_in_cents how much to take away from user balance
053     * @return modified balance
054     */
055    public int subtractCertainBalance(int cost_in_cents){
056        int startingValue = cost_in_cents;
057        for (int i = 0; i < changeSet.length; i++){
058            int spentAmount = cost_in_cents / acceptable_coin_vals[i];
059            cost_in_cents -= spentAmount * acceptable_coin_vals[i];
060            changeSet[i] -= spentAmount;
061        }
062        return startingValue-cost_in_cents;
063    }
064
065    /**
066     * Find out how many coins the machine should dispense
067     * @return string with the amount of coins that are being dispensed to make up for the balance that is left over. 
068     */
069    public String dispenseChange(){
070
071        String outputStrings = "";
072        int money = changeValue();
073        System.out.println(money);
074        outputStrings += "Golden Dollars: " + money / 100 + ", ";
075        money = money - (money / 100) * 100;
076        outputStrings += "Half Dollars: " + money / 50 + ", ";
077        money = money - (money / 50)*50;
078        outputStrings += "Quarter: " + money / 25 + ", ";
079        money = money - (money / 25)*25;
080        outputStrings += "Dime: " +  money / 10 + ", ";
081        money = money - (money / 10) * 10;
082        outputStrings += "Nickel: " + money / 5 + ", ";
083        money = money - (money / 5) * 5;
084        outputStrings += "Penny: " + money + ", ";
085        money = money - (money / 1);
086        if (money >0){
087            System.out.println("Could not dispense enough coins, IOU: " + money + " cents");
088        }
089        money = 0;
090        changeSet = new int[6];
091        return outputStrings;
092    }
093}
